purpose: Audit registry for candidate mappings from DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary concepts to external concept identifiers. It is deliberately separate from the canonical vocabulary.

policy.mappingDirectionNote: For sourceConcept skos:broadMatch targetConcept, the target concept is broader than the source concept. For sourceConcept skos:narrowMatch targetConcept, the target concept is narrower than the source concept.
policy.wikipediaRole: Contextual and conceptual evidence only by default, not a mapping target. Record semantically useful adjacent concepts even when the relationship is distant; state the exact connection and limitation. Wikipedia and DBpedia are not independent corroboration when the DBpedia resource derives from the same Wikipedia article.
policy.evidenceRecordingRule: Concept-level evidence may be recorded without asserting a SKOS mapping. Evidence links support interpretation and candidate discovery; they do not themselves establish mappingRelation.
